diff --git a/orgos/agile/flow_metric.py b/orgos/agile/flow_metric.py
index a6dc351..8e6dc3a 100644
--- a/orgos/agile/flow_metric.py
+++ b/orgos/agile/flow_metric.py
@@ -19,7 +19,11 @@ def takt_time(duration_seconds: float, n_issues: int) -> float:
     """Average calendar time per issue. Lower = faster flow.
 
     Returns 0.0 if no issues were processed (degenerate sprint).
+
+    Raises ValueError if duration_seconds is negative.
     """
+    if duration_seconds < 0:
+        raise ValueError('duration_seconds must be >= 0')
     if n_issues <= 0:
         return 0.0
     return duration_seconds / max(n_issues, 1)
diff --git a/tests/agile/test_takt_negative.py b/tests/agile/test_takt_negative.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f3781c0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/agile/test_takt_negative.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+"""Test that takt_time raises on negative duration."""
+
+import pytest
+from orgos.agile.flow_metric import takt_time
+
+
+def test_negative_duration_raises():
+    """Negative duration_seconds must raise ValueError."""
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        takt_time(-1.0, 5)
+
+
+def test_zero_duration_ok():
+    """Zero duration is valid and returns 0.0."""
+    assert takt_time(0.0, 1) == 0.0
+
+
+def test_positive_duration_ok():
+    """Positive duration returns correct takt time."""
+    assert takt_time(3600.0, 2) == 1800.0
